Document: supply-memo
Title: Green coffee supply: Q1 2027 plan
Classification: finance

Green coffee supply, Q1 2027. Finance only.

Cobalt Ridge Growers: contract price €6.42/kg green, fixed until 31 December. They have signalled an increase for 2027; we expect €6.90 to €7.10/kg.

Second supplier: we are in confidential talks with Marrowfield Estates for about 30% of volume from February, at an indicative €6.15/kg. Cobalt Ridge have not been told.

Effect on roasted prices: if Marrowfield signs, the price floors can hold through Q1. If not, list prices rise 4 to 5% from 1 February.
